title: Reprint · Lot C (re-inked, 2010)
logline: The papers run 2001 dailies re-inked. Same script. The 2010 hand. The book runs it beside the original.

margin.note: The 2001 gull, redrawn — and under the date, a second date: 2010.

panels.composition: The community-college parking lot in Newport, rain. WOOD in the Datsun, drawing on the wheel. Re-inked: the rain is a wash now, the Datsun has weight, the LOT C sign is lettered properly.

image.prompt: a young man drawing on a pad propped against the steering wheel of an old parked Datsun in a rainy college parking lot under a LOT C sign, re-inked in a mature confident brush line with a gray wash, the same composition as a crude earlier version
image.notes: Same panels as dw_2001-10-09_lot_c. The book prints them one above the other.

panels.composition: The security guard at the window, tapping.

image.prompt: a campus security guard tapping a car window in rain, a young man inside looking up, confident brush line

balloons.text: I'm auditing Composition II so I can use the print shop. Philosophically I'm auditing everything.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man's deadpan face through a half-rolled car window, mature brush line

panels.composition: The guard walking away. The car unmoved. The 2010 line makes the rain beautiful, which the 2001 line couldn't.

image.prompt: a guard walking away across a wet parking lot, an old Datsun unmoved, the rain rendered beautifully in wash, the same scene as a crude earlier version

notes: A reprint pair: the 2001 original and this. The father died in January (lean); the strip stopped; this is what ran. Nine months of it.
